notes: Release 0.10 - the cockpit is now a persistent icon rail plus the map and music: Apps, AutoKit, dashcam, phone, radio and settings always visible, with HOME appearing whenever an app covers the tiles. Control Center rebuilt on the car own panel: traffic jam, child and clean air modes, navigate home/work, media source, ambient, privacy, screen off, hotspot and the three volume sliders - climate removed, the third screen already owns it. The two layouts are separated in code, the keyboard survives a fresh install, and AutoKit installs as a system app with its permissions granted.
